# ship-pipelines

Your interface to the `pipelines` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Reads

- [`pipelines.list`](references/docs/pipelines.list.mdoc) — List pipeline definitions across scopes.
- [`pipelines.get`](references/docs/pipelines.get.mdoc) — Raw pipeline doc at the requested scope.
- [`pipelines.summaries`](references/docs/pipelines.summaries.mdoc) — Index-view shape: defs + active/history + pills + agents.
- [`pipelines.focus`](references/docs/pipelines.focus.mdoc) — Per-pipeline detail with active + other runs precomputed.
- [`pipelines.run`](references/docs/pipelines.run.mdoc) — Run detail with steps + timeline.
- [`pipelines.history`](references/docs/pipelines.history.mdoc) — Paginated run history with pipeline filter options.

## Commands

- [`pipelines.put`](references/docs/pipelines.put.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Create or replace a pipeline definition (by name).
- [`pipelines.patch`](references/docs/pipelines.patch.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Apply RFC-6902 ops to a pipeline definition.
- [`pipelines.delete`](references/docs/pipelines.delete.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Delete a pipeline definition (scope omitted walks project → user).
